note: Shared split convention for all three approaches (image_based, text_based, geometry_based). Splits are by base-shape NAME, never by file. 'pose' = every shape in train and test with different augmentation poses (pose-level only, NOT shape generalisation; label results accordingly). 'default' matches the legacy utils/prepare_data.py TEST_SHAPES=('Plus',), VAL_SHAPES=('T',). 'loso' = leave-one-shape-out folds.
edges_files: <Shape>.edges next to <Shape>.mid: one 'i j' pair per line, 0-based indices into the .mid points
